oracle.method: noise-free deterministic law Y_t = 0.01 + 2 X_{t-1} (X_t = 0.5 X_{t-1} + 0.1, X_0 = 0): the least-squares lag-1 fit recovers the line exactly, so the prediction at X_{t-1} = 1 is 2.01; the tolerance is floating-point round-off of that fit, not sampling error
context_only_outputs: README remark that the associational prediction equals the interventional mean only here
oracle.independence_basis: The generator builds the 80-row noise-free sequence from the stated recursion in exact rational arithmetic and fits the lag-1 line by the normal equations; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated recursion.

reference_review.limitations: Noise-free, linear and unconfounded, so the fit is exact and the check cannot detect behaviour under noise, autocorrelated errors or a mis-specified lag. The prediction is associational. No uncertainty or calibration.
